headline.purpose: One focused stage at a time.

shadows.name: workspace-ambient
shadows.purpose: The active orbit or camera workspace only.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Hover, active, and compact state transitions.

motion.name: breath-cycle
motion.purpose: Guided breathing scale loop, removed for reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single forward action in a stage.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 50px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; padding: 0 22px; background: var(--accent, #f16d56); color: var(--accent-ink, #28130e); font: 780 16px 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; transition: transform 180ms ease, background 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-strong, #db5944); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(.985); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #f16d56) 72%, transparent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quieter completion or skip action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 50px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #cbd5cd); border-radius: 999px; padding: 0 22px; background: var(--surface, #fafbf7); color: var(--ink, #17221c); font: 780 16px 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; transition: transform 180ms ease, background 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--surface-raised, #e9eee8); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #f16d56) 72%, transparent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Orbit Panel
components.description: The elevated home workspace that turns free time into an action.
components.html:
Your day has room.

Next opening: 9:23 AM
components.css: .ds-panel { border-radius: 16px; padding: 28px; background: var(--surface, #fafbf7); color: var(--ink, #17221c); box-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(46, 67, 54, .13); font-family: 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: -.02em; } .ds-panel p { margin: 8px 0 0; color: var(--muted, #5e6b63); }

components.name: Energy Choice
components.description: A large, accessible pre-session energy selection.
components.css: .ds-energy { min-height: 180px; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #cbd5cd); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--surface, #fafbf7); color: var(--ink, #17221c); text-align: left; display: flex; flex-direction: column; font-family: 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; transition: transform 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease, background 180ms ease; } .ds-energy strong { margin-top: auto; font-size: 24px; } .ds-energy span { color: var(--muted, #5e6b63); } .ds-energy:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); border-color: var(--accent, #f16d56); } .ds-energy:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #f16d56) 72%, transparent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Session Result
components.description: A sparse three-part completion summary with tabular numerals.
components.css: .ds-result { padding: 24px 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #cbd5cd); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #cbd5cd); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-family: 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-result strong { font-size: 24px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -.03em; } .ds-result span { color: var(--muted, #5e6b63); font-size: 12px; }

narrative.overview: Between is a calm, operate-first wellness product. Open time becomes a visible material through orbital markers, one coral movement window, and a seven-day loop.
keyCharacteristics: Cool mineral surfaces with one coral action voice.
Circular geometry reserved for time, completion, and compact controls.
Strong asymmetric composition on wide screens and strict single-column structure on mobile.
Motion used only to explain state, progress, breath, or feedback.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Coral is the only action accent. It never competes with a second decorative hue.

rules.name: The Theme Parity Rule
rules.body: The same hierarchy and interaction contrast must hold in both system themes.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Weight, scale, and color create hierarchy; additional display families do not.

rules.name: The One Lift Rule
rules.body: Elevation identifies the current workspace, never every container.

dos: Do keep guest mode complete and integrations visibly optional.
Do use circles for time, progress, completion, and compact controls.
Do preserve keyboard focus, reduced motion, system dark mode, and camera-free completion.
Do let motion explain a change in state.
donts: Don't introduce calorie, diagnosis, injury-correction, or body-shaming language.
Don't add a second accent color or decorative glow.
Don't wrap routine metadata in nested cards.
Don't persist camera frames, pose landmarks, or joint angles.
